## Why

`stranske/Doc-Lineage#28` merged the extraction library for `#3`, but the required production-code deliberate-break test gate is not evidenced in the squash diff or PR body.

`src/doc_lineage/extract/pdf.py` detects missing text layers per page and invokes OCR fallback (merge SHA `c3fa0461a15333a6f0f8d351fb53e2fa9491b883`). `tests/test_extract_coverage.py::test_mixed_pdf_recognizes_only_missing_text_layer_page` guards this behavior. PR #28 compares expected counts without mutating production code or including RED/GREEN output.

## Scope

Complete the `#3` deliberate-break gate in a follow-up PR.

## Non-Goals

Do not remove OCR fallback, cache-keying, or office-format readers.

No scaffolding or TODO-only changes.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update `src/doc_lineage/extract/pdf.py` to temporarily treat the whole document as text-layer-present when any page has text.
- [ ] Test `pytest tests/test_extract_coverage.py::test_mixed_pdf_recognizes_only_missing_text_layer_page -q` and capture the failing output.
- [ ] Update `src/doc_lineage/extract/pdf.py` to restore per-page text-layer detection, rerun the named test, and paste RED and GREEN output blocks in the PR body.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/test_extract_coverage.py::test_mixed_pdf_recognizes_only_missing_text_layer_page -q` passes on `main`.
- [ ] The per-document deliberate break in `src/doc_lineage/extract/pdf.py` causes the named test to fail, and reverting it causes the test to pass.
- [ ] The follow-up PR body contains captured RED and GREEN output blocks.

## Implementation Notes

Surfaced by `D4-verify-merged-2026-09-13T01`; verified against the PR #28 squash diff at merge SHA `c3fa0461`.
